Evidence: 2009 mein Andhra Pradesh ke elections mein Congress ne 156 seats jeeti thi, jo ki 294 total constituencies mein se hai. Iska matlab hai ki Congress apne peak par thi aur unhone 20 seats nahi jeeti, balki kaafi zyada seats jeeti. Source 1 ke mutabik, Congress ka vote share 36.55% tha, jo unki majbooti ko darshata hai.
Justification: Retrieved evidence se yeh pata chalta hai ki Congress ne 2009 mein Andhra Pradesh se 156 seats jeeti thi, jo claim ke core assertion ko directly contradict karta hai. Isliye, yeh claim ki Congress ne sirf 20 seats jeeti thi, galat hai. Source 1 mein diya gaya data Congress ki majbooti aur unke jeete gaye seats ki sankhya ko darshata hai.
